paper_title: Langzeit-Trends bei kommunalen Unternehmen: mehr und komplexere Auslagerungen
caption: Entwicklung der durchschnittlichen Auslagerungsintensität (34 NRW-Städte), 1998 bis 2017
model_annotation: The diagram illustrates the development of average outsourcing intensity in 34 cities in North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW) from 1998 to 2017, comparing three different categories. The x-axis represents the years, ranging from 1998 to 2017 in increments of one year, while the y-axis represents index values, ranging from 3 to 9 in increments of 1. The three categories are represented by distinct lines: "Konzern Kommune" (green, solid line), "Direkte/indirekte Beteiligungen 1. Grades" (purple, solid line), and "Direkte Beteiligungen" (blue, solid line). The green line, representing "Konzern Kommune," starts at approximately 6 in 1998 and ends at around 8.7 in 2017, with a steady increase until 2008, followed by a slight decline and stabilization between 2009 and 2012, and then a gradual rise again. The purple line, representing "Direkte/indirekte Beteiligungen 1. Grades," begins at around 5.5 in 1998 and reaches approximately 7.5 in 2017, with a similar trend to the green line, but with a more moderate increase. The blue line, representing "Direkte Beteiligungen," starts at about 3.5 in 1998 and ends at around 4.3 in 2017, with a relatively stable trend, experiencing a slight increase until 2004, followed by a plateau.
